title: Geopolitical Energy Tightening Meets Slower Global Growth
description: OPEC+ output cuts and Strait of Hormuz risks are lifting oil prices and global transport costs, sustaining inflation pressures across economies. Meanwhile, signs of cooling US activity and hawkish policy expectations suggest growth is slowing, elevating stagflation risks and weighing on risk assets.

title: Tech Momentum Supports Global Growth Prospects
description: Apple's record revenue, strong iPhone demand, and double-digit Services growth signal resilient consumer spending and a high-margin services ecosystem. The added dividend increase and expanded buyback reinforce cash-flow confidence, underpinning tech-led growth and a favorable signal for global markets.
